Titel: Security boundary: session-scoped agent credentials and cross-session authorization
Begründung: Echte Sitzungstrennung fehlt innerhalb eines Projekt-Runners: gemeinsamer UID/HOME/Proxy. Sicherheitsumfang ist Projektisolation, keine Identität einzelner Agentensitzungen.
Kosten/Nutzen: Per-session isolation would need all of the following. A root broker in the supervisor spawning each session under its own UID (the runner has no capabilities and cannot setuid). Per-session HOME. Workspace write sharing via group or ACLs, which reopens cross-session file influence anyway. A per-session proxy socket with SO_PEERCRED or a per-session listener. A hub principal model plus a route matrix. A per-session network namespace if egress matters. This is a large cross-layer and installation change with uncertain interaction with Claude and Codex state directories. Not feasible as a hardened deliverable this release; a half-version would invite false claims.
Prüfung: Hub-/Proxytests prüfen Projekt-ACL und Ownerroute-Sperren. Peer-Tests behaupten keine trust=session. F6/U2 bleibt offen und ausdrücklich dokumentiert.
